about_short_description.short_description: AstroForge is an asteroid mining company that extracts gold and other minerals from asteroid.

product.name: Odin Spacecraft
product.description: A 100 kg spacecraft designed for deep space flyby missions to capture high-resolution images and analyze asteroid composition.

product.name: Vestri Mission Spacecraft
product.description: A spacecraft planned for 2026 designed to land on an asteroid and extract valuable resources, including platinum group metals.

product.name: Asteroid Material Processing Technology
product.description: A laser-based system that vaporizes asteroid material into nanoparticles for efficient processing and extraction of valuable metals.

product.name: Platinum Group Metals Refinement System
product.description: An automated system that separates platinum group metals from other asteroid materials with 99.9% purity using magnetic and electrochemical methods.

identifier.value: Cryogenic Storage System for Enriched PGMs

product.name: Cryogenic Storage System for Enriched PGMs
product.description: A storage system that safely contains enriched platinum group metals at ultra-low temperatures during transport back to Earth.

product.name: Re-entry and Delivery System
product.description: A spacecraft system designed to safely return enriched asteroid metals to Earth using autonomous navigation and thermal protection.
